title: 电影放映信息
paragraphs:
WANNER VILLAGE
Film: Harry Potter (3 hours)
Date: Sunday
Time: 2:00 p.m.
Price: £4.20 (adults); £3.50 (children under 18)
Tel.: 0115-845616

HOLLYWOOD THEATER
Film: Catch Me If You Can (2 hours and 35 minutes)
Date: Saturday and Sunday
Time: 4:00 p.m.
Price: £3.00
Tel.: 0115-806163

THE KING’S CINEMA
Film: The Twins (1 hour and 40 minutes)
Date: Monday to Friday
Time: 2:30 p.m.
Price: £2.00 (free tickets for children under 10)
Tel.: 0115-831931

THE ROYAL THEATER
Film: I Spy (2 hours)
Date: Monday to Friday
Time: 9:00 a.m.
Price: £2.00
Tel.: 0115-873420

questions.reason: 选C：The Twins。把各影片时长换为分钟：Harry Potter为180，Catch Me If You Can为155，The Twins为100，I Spy为120。100分钟最短；题目比较时长，不是票价或放映开始的时间。

questions.stem: You can see the film Harry Potter on ____.
questions.reason: 选B：Sunday。在WANNER VILLAGE下定位Harry Potter，其Date一项为Sunday。Saturday and Sunday属于Catch Me If You Can，Monday to Friday属于另两部影片；须核对同一影片栏目，不能横向串行。

questions.stem: If you want to book a ticket for the film Catch Me If You Can, you can dial ____.
questions.reason: 选D：0115-806163。先定位Catch Me If You Can所在的HOLLYWOOD THEATER，再读同一栏Tel.。其余号码分别属于别的影院；题目不要求任选售票电话，而是要与指定影片一致。

questions.stem: If Mr Green and his 9-year-old son go to see the film The Twins, they need to pay ____.
questions.reason: 选D：£2.00。The Twins票价为£2，且children under 10免费。父亲付£2，9岁儿子属于10岁以下，不收费，总计£2；不能按两张普通票算£4，也不能套用Harry Potter的儿童票价。

questions.stem: If you want to see a film in the morning, you can only go to ____.
questions.reason: 选A：THE ROYAL THEATER。它的Time为9:00 a.m.，属于上午；其他影院分别为2:00 p.m.、4:00 p.m.、2:30 p.m.，均是下午。关键是辨别a.m./p.m.，不是只比较钟面数字大小。
